styles.name: pokemon-hp
styles.description: Pokémon battle HUD: a Poké Ball wobbles mid-capture beside an `HP` bar that fills with progress; the ball settles at 100%

styles.name: nokia-snake
styles.description: Nokia-style snake grows from left; segments = progress, pellets sparkle with time

styles.name: tetris-gb
styles.description: Game Boy Tetris: I, O, L and J tetrominoes, each with its own block texture, lock into a solid stack left-to-right while the next piece drops in; stack length = progress

styles.name: dr-mario
styles.description: Dr. Mario: wriggling viruses vanish from the medicine bottle as a capsule drops through its neck; the capsule row beside it fills with progress

styles.name: kirby-inhale
styles.description: Pink Kirby with red feet and rosy cheeks walks right with progress, mouth wide, inhaling a stream of stars and Waddle Dees

styles.name: tamagotchi
styles.description: Tamagotchi: an egg-shaped toy with LCD window and three buttons; the pet grows baby→adult and toddles about while the hunger hearts fill with progress

styles.name: game-watch
styles.description: Game & Watch Ball: an LCD juggler under three arcs of ghosted ball segments; balls hop segment to segment, more join and score ticks light as progress rises

styles.name: hearts
styles.description: Link's Awakening HUD: B/A item boxes with shield and sword beside two rows of seven heart containers filling half a heart at a time; the next heart blinks

styles.name: mole-whack
styles.description: Whack-a-Mole: moles bob from a row of holes, a red mallet slams the next one; whacked moles see stars — whacked count = progress

styles.name: wario-treasure
styles.description: Wario Land treasure: spinning gold coins arc into an open treasure chest while the coin stacks beside it grow with progress

styles.name: lcd-pinball
styles.description: LCD pinball table: plunger, six round pop bumpers and twin flippers; bumpers light up solid as progress rises while the ball ricochets with time
